title: Kirk McConnell confirms blue-on-blue firefight and human transport in reverse-engineered craft
place_text: SOL conference; Senate Armed Services Committee

tellings.quote: Yeah, because at Soul he was asked by a couple individuals if he had heard of a blue-on-blue firefight team with a locky brushal team and about you know transporting humans in reverse engineered craft and he said both he had heard yes.

plain: A man named Kirk McConnell, whose story is tied to the Senate Armed Services Committee, is said to have confirmed two startling things when people questioned him at a UFO conference called SOL: he had heard of a "blue-on-blue" firefight, meaning American forces fighting each other, involving some security team, and he had heard of humans being carried in "reverse-engineered craft", vehicles built by copying recovered non-human technology. The researcher who posts online as UAPGerb tells Michels this, without saying where he heard it, and he links it to Senator Kirsten Gillibrand. If true, it would mean someone close to Congress had heard that secret craft programmes exist and have even led to deadly clashes.
